title: AIMBOT ESP KILL ALL ABILITIES SILENT AIM TRIGGERBOT
features:
InvalidX | MVSD v4.1 —

🏠 MAIN





Auto Unanchor — move before match freeze ends



Autoshoot — auto-fires at closest visible enemy



Auto Throw Knife — auto-throws knife at enemies



Trigger Bot — fires when crosshair is on enemy



Hitbox Expander — bigger enemy hitboxes



Remove Gun Cooldown — spam guns



Bullet Tracer Color — custom beam color

FOV + Distance + Ignore Friends sliders

👁 ESP





Charms — full-body highlight



Skeleton — bone lines



Tracers — lines to enemies



Team/Enemy color pickers

💀 KILL





Kill All (Gun) — once or auto



Kill All (Knife) — once or auto

⚡ ABILITIES





Auto Shroud — blinds all enemies



Low Executor Mode — skips visuals for FPS



Remove cooldowns — sprint / dash / shroud / soul reap



Stat boosts — sprint speed, soul reap, propeller jump, shroud range/speed

🗺 TELEPORT





Auto Walk to Duel Pads — auto-queues for matches



8 manual pad buttons — 1v1 / 2v2 / 3v3 / 4v4, left/right

🎯 FOV





FOV Circle — visual ring around mouse



Auto Shoot FOV — fires at anything in circle



Manual Shoot FOV — LMB to fire at circle

📁 MISC





Noclip



Speed Changer (16–200)



Auto Spin — daily wheel



Anti-AFK

Theme switcher

Rebind UI toggle (default: RightCtrl)



Toggle UI: RightCtrl
